subtasks.details: Create caching mechanism for game state analysis to avoid redundant LLM calls. Develop mock response generators that simulate DSpy module outputs for testing scenarios. Integrate caching with API endpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test cache hit/miss scenarios and mock response accuracy

subtasks.title: Integrate DSpy Optimizers for Strategy Improvement
subtasks.description: Implement DSpy optimizers like BootstrapFewShot to improve strategy quality through examples.
subtasks.details: Set up dspy.BootstrapFewShot optimizer with diplomacy game examples. Create training data from successful game scenarios. Integrate optimizer into DiplomacyStrategist for improved strategic reasoning.
subtasks.testStrategy: Compare strategy quality before and after optimization with test scenarios

subtasks.title: Conduct End-to-End Integration Testing
subtasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing of the complete LLM integration with Go backend in full game simulations.
subtasks.details: Set up test environments simulating complete game flows from Go backend to Python service. Test API communication, DSpy module responses, caching behavior, and error handling in realistic diplomacy scenarios.
subtasks.testStrategy: Full game simulation tests with AI decision validation and performance benchmarking
